# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 36 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 37 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_036_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 36

**1** Jesus said: "Do not worry from morning until evening and from evening until morning about what you will wear."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- The double temporal sweep (morning to evening, evening to morning) = all hours; no break in the prohibition
- Only clothing mentioned in the Coptic; P.Oxy 655 adds food and the lilies passage
- The minimalist Coptic form focuses the anxiety-prohibition on bodily covering alone

---
